name: Kuru
sum: Dromaeosaurid from the Barun Goyot Formation of Mongolia known from a fragmentary skeleton with a partial skull.
holotype: A fragmentary skeleton including a partial skull, Barun Goyot Formation, Khulsan, Mongolia; reported as a new dromaeosaurid in 1992.
biology: Named after the Tibetan Buddhist deity Kurukullā, not after the disease kuru (Napoli et al. 2021).
author: Napoli et al. 2021

sources.text: J. G. Napoli, A. A. Ruebenstahl, and B. A. S. Bhullar, A. H. Turner, M. A. Norell. 2021. A New Dromaeosaurid (Dinosauria: Coelurosauria) from Khulsan, Central Mongolia. American Museum Novitates 3982:1-47
